title: Habakkuk — Instructions and Commands
content:
Habakkuk — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

4 additional passage records · 4 quoted verse units. Read Habakkuk in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Work, possessions and stewardship

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Uncertain · 2 passage records

Habakkuk 2:2

Record type: Prophetic instruction or reported speech. Source section: I Will Stand at My Watch.

Habakkuk 2:2 — The Lord answered me: “Write a vision clearly on a boxwood tablet, so that the one reading these things may pursue them.

Context and scope: Distinguish the prophet’s commission, covenant exhortation, quoted human speech and judgment rhetoric. Application beyond the original addressee remains open unless evidence is supplied.

Habakkuk 2:16

Record type: Judgment rhetoric. Source section: Woe to the One Building a City with Bloodshed.

Habakkuk 2:16 — Drink, you too, a fullness of dishonor instead of glory; be tossed and shaken! The cup of the Lord’s right hand has come around to you, and dishonor has gathered upon your glory.

Context and scope: An imperative within a prophetic judgment scene, often addressing a doomed city or personified object. This is not a command for readers to inflict violence or reproduce the described events.

Work, possessions and stewardship

Historical — rejected · 1 passage records

Habakkuk 2:19

Record type: Reported hostile or rejected order. Source section: What Use Is a Carved Image?.

Habakkuk 2:19 — Woe to the one saying to wood, ‘Wake and rise!’ and to stone, ‘Be lifted up!’ It is an appearance, a plate of gold and silver, and no breath at all is in it.

Context and scope: This order is recorded as hostile, coercive or contrary to faithful obedience in its narrative context. It is not included as a divine command to obey.
